title: channel.py: ZeroDivisionError if superframe_duration_us is 0
description: Line 58: `(unix_time_us - epoch_base_us) // superframe_duration_us` will crash if superframe_duration_us is 0. GnssHopConfig accepts arbitrary int values with no validation. A misconfigured config or deserialized corrupt data causes uncaught exception.
close_reason: sfn_from_unix_time returns 0 when superframe_duration_us <= 0 (matches rust/lichen-core). GNSS path no longer ZeroDivisionError. pytest tests/link/test_channel.py 33 passed.
